author: ZapTV
name: ZapTV
description: Nostr-native zap display for your npub.
long_description: Connect an LNbits, Nostr Wallet Connect, or on-chain (xpub) wallet and ZapTV shows your most recent zaps with a lightning-strike effect, alongside your Nostr profile picture and a receive QR for your npub.cash Lightning address. Display-only: it holds no keys and shows no balance, so it is safe to leave running in public.
